title: Trans Elytra
description: Puts a trans flag on the elytra item texture!
body:
There is now a trans flag on the elytra item texture! :3

This only affects the item texture. If you want the model to be a trans flag, I suggest using [MinecraftCapes](https://modrinth.com/project/9gNVPfzw) to add a custom elytra texture for only yourself.
